I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I said I'm treating "Gate 34 is the Marlowe rollout site at Quarrendon Freight Lines" as an unconfirmed rumor, and I won't use it as the site until someone confirms it.

I couldn't confirm or rule it out from what Hollis can see. Nothing in #central-team mentions it, and I found no Quarrendon account files they can open. I stuck to Hollis's own access and didn't read the Quarrendon incident channel (#inc-qfl-sev1) or #north-team, since Hollis isn't in either.
